For patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC), defective mismatch repair (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) status strongly predicts benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Based on the phase III KEYNOTE-177 and CheckMate 8HW trials, first-line treatment with ICIs, either anti-PD-1 monotherapy or anti-PD-1 + anti-CTLA-4 combination therapy, has become the standard of care for these patients.
